extraction_scope: worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from Results/Discussion, Figures 1-7, and Supplementary Figure S1 text

mechanism_claims.claim_text: K13L shows a time-dependent candidacidal phenotype against Candida albicans SC5314 in CFU assays, with source prose reporting approximately 50%, 81%, and 94% killing at MFC after 30, 60, and 120 min.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=12:3.1. In Vitro Fungicidal Activity of Selected Peptides; xml:fig=1:Figure 1

mechanism_claims.limitations: CFU time-kill supports fungicidal phenotype but does not identify the molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Circular dichroism supports K13L conformational change from random coil in aqueous solution to alpha-helical structure in SDS model membrane conditions.
mechanism_claims.limitations: SDS is a membrane-mimetic environment; this is not promoted to direct cellular target proof.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM and SEM images support K13L-associated Candida cell ultrastructure and morphology alteration after treatment.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The microscopy supports cellular damage morphology, not a single molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Confocal microscopy of FITC-labeled K13L supports peptide internalization over time and association with propidium iodide-positive cell death signal.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: FITC-labeled K13L in Candida albicans cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: The assay supports internalization and death association; it does not prove a receptor or intracellular molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: K13L improves survival in a Candida albicans-infected Galleria mellonella model with a reported log-rank p value of 0.0098, while separate K13L injection did not show in vivo toxicity in the same model.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: K13L in Galleria mellonella candidiasis model
mechanism_claims.limitations: In vivo survival is therapeutic phenotype evidence, not a direct mechanism assay.

source_review_notes: Mechanism claims distinguish CFU/time-kill and in vivo phenotypes from direct microscopy assays.
CD in SDS is retained as inferred/model-membrane support rather than cellular target proof.
Supplementary Figure S1 lacks tabulated quadrant percentages; exact apoptosis quantification is not promoted.
